mapper.select: /*selectCommonMpIvOrderInfoPopList*/ SELECT A.REF_PR_NO AS REF_PR_NO, --[00] A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, --[01] A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, --[02] A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, --[03] A.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY, --[04] A.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, --[05] A.AGENT_PRICE AS AGENT_PRICE, --[06] A.AGENT_ITEM_AMT AS AGENT_ITEM_AMT, --[07] -- DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE, '0',A.RD_DATE, F_GET_DATE_TR(A.RD_DATE)) AS RD_DATE, A.RD_DATE, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, --[09] A.CONTRACT_NO, --[10] A.CONTRACT_SEQ, --[11] A.MAKER_NAME, --[12] B.DOC_TYPE, --[13] DECODE(B.DOC_TYPE,'X',SUBSTR(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7), ( SELECT STDCATLG_ID FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CONTRACT_NO = A.CONTRACT_NO AND CONTRACT_SEQ = A.CONTRACT_SEQ)) AS STDCATLG_ID, --[14] DECODE(B.DOC_TYPE,'X',( SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, --[15] (SELECT MAX(PR.IMAGE_KEY) FROM ICOMPRDT PR WHERE PR.BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR.PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND PR.PR_SEQ = A.PR_SEQ) AS IMAGE_KEY, --[16] DECODE((SELECT MAX(PR.IMAGE_KEY) FROM ICOMPRDT PR WHERE PR.BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR.PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND PR.PR_SEQ = A.PR_SEQ),NULL,'','Y') AS IMAGE_KEY_YN, A.PO_REMARK, --[17] A.ST_DATE FROM ICOMPODT A , ICOMPOHD B WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D'
